name: Shine
description: Shine is a website template for cleaning companies, with services, a before and after comparison, indicative prices and a quote form. Clear typography, a turquoise accent and deep navy give the website a fresh, local character. Replace the copy, photos, company details, prices and reviews with your own before publishing.
features: Hero with a quick quote estimate
Before and after comparison, to be replaced with your own photos
Four services: homes and apartments, offices, windows and post-renovation cleaning
Indicative prices per square metre with a description of the scope
Process from the first enquiry to the cleaning date
Client reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
Contact details and a quote form
Navigation, company details and legal links
